name: danny-skills
description: Personal skill pack: dt-plan, dt-visualize-plan, dt-prototype, dt-review, dt-build (a plan -> visualize -> optional prototype -> critique -> build pipeline), dt-writing-draft and dt-writing-edit (sourced drafting and editing for letters, papers, and copy), dt-starter-session-audit (scope-aware end-of-session capture routing rules, facts, and terminology across CLAUDE.md / MEMORY.md / CONTEXT.md / glossary.md with a conflict policy), and dt-handoff for single-use session continuity.

changelog: 0.8.0 phase-7b-dt-build-execution: completed dt-build execution parity by adding deterministic execution scripts (assemble-codex-prompt, verify-codex-prompt, dev-cas-update), wiring codex prompt verify-gate and dev compare-and-swap flow, and preserving Phase-7A roadmap-intake contract behavior.

0.7.0 phase-0-foundation: repo-level references/scripts/assets scaffolding; canonical dimension contract + glossary contract single sources; security primitives (wrap-prompt-envelope, redact-secrets) + redaction corpus; vendored mermaid 10.9.3 (SHA256-pinned); upstream-deps governance + fallback table; skill-template scaffold.

0.7.0 phase-1-dt-plan: renamed dt-design-build -> dt-plan onto the Anthropic standard (SKILL.md 2.2k words); CDC + glossary-placement rules now point at repo-level references; surface templates + plan-shape/shape_version policy extracted to dt-plan/references; junction reparse-target resolution added to conventions.md; junctions repaired on CLI x3 + Codex; live cross-skill references updated; no plugin version bump (milestone-based policy).

0.7.0 phase-2-dt-visualize-plan: added dt-visualize-plan (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill) plus shared visualize runtime (html-builder + mermaid-wrap + template/tokens); renders plan-view.html with milestone table, optional mermaid graph/gantt, fallback dependency provenance footer, and vendored mermaid-only loading.

0.7.0 phase-3-dt-prototype: added dt-prototype (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill) adapted from Matt Pocock's MIT prototype pattern; split logic/UI branches under references/ with vendored starter templates for terminal TUI (TypeScript/Python) and UI variant switching; dt-plan now routes behavior-validatable questions through dt-prototype before adversarial review.

0.7.0 phase-4-dt-review: renamed dt-design-loop -> dt-review with Anthropic-standard frontmatter; extracted input modes, codex prompt template, recovery, finalization, and design-shape contracts into dt-review/references; pointer-swapped CDC to repo-level canonical contract; added deterministic round scripts (preflight, invoke, verdict parse, provenance capture); updated cross-skill references and junction topology for CLI/Codex surfaces.

0.7.0 phase-5-dt-visualize-design: added dt-visualize-design (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill), section-level markdown diff engine, and shared design-diff rendering mode that outputs design-view.html with [ADDED]/[CHANGED]/[REMOVED] badges, change-summary header, and Phase-2-equivalent dependency provenance fallback behavior.

0.7.0 phase-6-dt-roadmap: added dt-roadmap (Anthropic-standard greenfield skill), canonical roadmap schema contract (producer_current_version + schema_version: 1), roadmap validator (cycle/independence/parallelism/schema major-match checks), milestones exporter with xlsx primary and csv+markdown fallback, and Phase-2 mermaid/shared-security primitive reuse.

0.7.0 phase-7a-dt-build-intake: refactored dt-build for roadmap-driven intake parity (Anthropic-standard split with assets/references/scripts), added deterministic intake scaffolding scripts and hard-cutover rejection for pre-refactor .dt-build run folders, and wired intake validation to dt-roadmap's canonical validator/schema via repo-relative path.
